headline: Ciclovía returns to King City this Sunday
summary: KING CITY — King City’s Ciclovía will return Sunday, Oct. 11, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m., with Broadway Street closed to vehicle traffic between First Street and San Lorenzo Avenue.
source: King City Rustler / South County Newspapers
